domain_invariants.requirement: Table, reservation, and waitlist ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive ids are not found. All timestamps are offset-aware UTC ISO-8601 values from 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2035-12-31T23:59:59Z.
A table has a unique uppercase code matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]{0,11}$, seats 1..20, zone in INDOOR, TERRACE, BAR, PRIVATE, and active boolean.

A reservation references one active table, has guest_name trimmed 2..120 characters, party_size 1..20, start_at and end_at on five-minute UTC boundaries, duration 30..180 minutes, and end_at later than start_at.

For a table and interval, sum party_size of BOOKED and OFFERED capacity holds must not exceed table.seats, using [start_at,end_at) overlap; shared endpoints do not overlap. CANCELLED reservations and CANCELLED or EXPIRED waitlist entries consume no capacity.

A waitlist entry records guest_name 2..120 characters, party_size 1..20, requested start_at and end_at following REQ-4-003, and status WAITING, OFFERED, ACCEPTED, CANCELLED, or EXPIRED. WAITING order is ascending immutable waitlist id, not wall-clock time.

Cancelling a BOOKED reservation retains immutable cancelled_at, cancellation_reason 3..500 trimmed characters, and cancelling actor. In the same transaction the system offers the cancelled table capacity to the lowest-id matching WAITING entry that fits, stores that table as held_table_id, and changes the entry to OFFERED with a supplied offer_expires_at later than cancelled_at; the offer holds that table capacity.

Accepting an OFFERED entry requires accepted_at not later than offer_expires_at and atomically creates one BOOKED reservation using its request data and held_table_id, then marks the entry ACCEPTED. Explicit expiry is allowed only at or after offer_expires_at and releases the hold.

A user may operate only reservations and waitlist entries created by that user; admins manage tables and access all records. A table cannot be deleted while any reservation references it; deletion never cascades.
Availability is computed from current local data for an explicit requested interval and party_size only; it writes no hold or reservation and does not depend on the wall clock or external services.

Lists use ascending id order, limit 1..100 default 20, optional after_id greater than zero, and nullable next_after_id. All writes are atomic and roll back reservations, waitlist state, and capacity effects on errors.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all other endpoints require a valid non-expired local Bearer session.
Seed data contains two users, one admin, active tables, one BOOKED reservation, one WAITING entry, and one OFFERED entry with an explicit future expiry timestamp.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON returns 400, wrong media type returns 415, and valid JSON violating declared fields returns 422.
The API is local and deterministic. Local persistence unavailability returns 503 and unexpected failures return 500 without changing state.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-4-011; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged; error has no effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /tables to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional zone, min_seats 1..20, active boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-002 and REQ-4-010, return stable non-deleted rows without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListTables(request):
    // REQ-4-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ matching tables by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition and errors leave state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /tables to an admin, accepting JSON code, seats, zone, and optional active default true; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-002, atomically create a unique table, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tables/{table_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall apply REQ-4-001, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTable(request, table_id):
    // REQ-4-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; IF invalid, absent, or deleted id THEN RETURN 404. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors preserve all relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id and JSON code, seats, zone, or active; it shall require application/json, validate the resulting REQ-4-002 and REQ-4-004 capacity, atomically update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve reservations and waitlist holds, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /tables/{table_id} to an admin, accepting a positive table_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a table without reservation references under REQ-4-008, be idempotent only insofar as an absent id is 404, not cascade to history, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /reservations to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional positive table_id, status in BOOKED or CANCELLED, from, to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-003, ordered half-open time filters, and REQ-4-010, restrict users to their rows, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListReservations(request):
    // REQ-4-017; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422; unknown table is 404.
    READ matching rows by id, restricted to creator for user; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; state unchanged on all outcomes.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /reservations to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON positive table_id, guest_name, party_size, start_at, and end_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 through REQ-4-004, atomically create a BOOKED reservation only when capacity remains, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /reservations/{reservation_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-008, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetReservation(request, reservation_id):
    // REQ-4-019; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent id; REQUIRE creator or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged even after errors.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /reservations/{reservation_id}/cancel to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive reservation_id and JSON cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, and offer_expires_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-004, and REQ-4-006, atomically cancel BOOKED status and offer the released table capacity to the first fitting WAITING entry, be non-idempotent, retain reservation history, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /waitlist to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional status, from, to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-005, ordered interval filters, and REQ-4-010, restrict users to caller-created entries, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListWaitlist(request):
    // REQ-4-021; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE enum, range, and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ matching entries by id, restricted to creator for user; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: wait order and persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /waitlist to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON guest_name, party_size, start_at, and end_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-003, and REQ-4-005, atomically create a WAITING entry owned by the caller without holding capacity, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /waitlist/{waitlist_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive waitlist_id; it shall enforce REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-008, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetWaitlistEntry(request, waitlist_id):
    // REQ-4-023; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent id; REQUIRE creator or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged on all errors.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose DELETE /waitlist/{waitlist_id} to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive waitlist_id; it shall atomically mark a WAITING or OFFERED entry CANCELLED, release an OFFERED hold, retain historical data, be non-idempotent, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /waitlist/{waitlist_id}/accept to its creator user or an admin, accepting a positive waitlist_id and JSON accepted_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001, REQ-4-002, REQ-4-004, and REQ-4-007, atomically turn a valid OFFERED entry into one BOOKED reservation on its held_table_id, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /waitlist/{waitlist_id}/expire to an admin, accepting a positive waitlist_id and JSON expired_at; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-4-001 and REQ-4-007, atomically expire only an OFFERED entry at or after its offer_expires_at, release its hold, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /availability to an authenticated user or admin, accepting start_at, end_at, party_size 1..20, and optional zone; it shall validate REQ-4-001 through REQ-4-004 and REQ-4-009, return matching tables and remaining seats without creating a hold, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetAvailability(request):
    // REQ-4-027; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE interval, party size, and zone OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ active tables and current BOOKED/OFFERED demand; RETURN 200 candidates under REQ-4-004. Transaction: none; postcondition: no capacity hold exists and errors change nothing.
